identification: Genuine ex-council aluminium blade street name sign 'MURRAY St' (superscript T), about 60 cm long: extruded aluminium blade with rolled top and bottom flanges, white (reflective-type) face with black block capitals, still fitted with its cast aluminium pole-top clamp/bracket (grub screw and bolt visible). Not an enamel sign and not a reproduction: the extrusion profile, the real mounting clamp, wear and dirt along the lower edge are all consistent with a sign that stood on a pole. Style (black on white, superscript 'St') matches late 20th century Tasmanian council blade signs, roughly 1970s-2000s. Most likely Murray Street, Hobart (the CBD street), but Murray Streets also exist elsewhere and nothing on the sign says which town. Only one photo, front only.
